visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair wearing a black tank top and a young woman with a ponytail in a white tank top stand close together, looking at a smartphone screen. The setting is a brightly lit indoor living room with a ceiling fan and a visible air conditioner. (2) The scene shifts to the couple standing on a brown yoga mat; the woman leans her body forward while the man supports her shoulders. She loses her balance and collapses onto the mat, her face wide with laughter. (3) They stand up and talk to each other; the woman adjusts her hair while the man gestures toward the camera. Behind them, a dining table and a wine rack are visible in the background. (4) The couple successfully performs a partner movement where the woman leans into a plank position held by the man; they celebrate with a joyful hug and a high-five. (5) The roles reverse as the man leans back into the woman's arms; she struggles to maintain his weight, her facial expression showing intense effort. They eventually both tumble onto the floor as the man laughs.

(2) A sharp, high-pitched female laugh is heard alongside a dull thudding sound, indicating an impact on a soft surface. The speech rate increases with vocal excitement. (3) Continuous conversational chatter with moderate loudness; the female voice exhibits audible breathiness from exertion. Background room tone is minimal. (4) The speakers perform rhythmic humming in unison ('Deng deng deng...'), which transitions into a fuller BGM swell. High-arousal cheering and clapping follow the rhythm. (5) Heavy exhales and grunts of physical effort are heard from both speakers. A loud, sharp female scream occurs, followed immediately by sustained, high-energy laughter from both parties as the audio track fades.
